purpose: Static dependency and published-license review supporting the commercial plus MIT Office design. This is not a final release SBOM or legal approval.

exceptions.finding: No license field in package metadata; published package/LICENSE contains Apache-2.0.
exceptions.action: Use the actual Apache-2.0 license and preserve it in notices.
Select the MIT option and preserve its copyright and permission notice.
Preserve both applicable license texts; AND is not a choice.

exceptions.finding: Complete permission text is in README rather than a standalone LICENSE file.
exceptions.action: Collect README license sections before pruning package documentation.

exceptions.finding: No full standalone license in tarball; MIT license located in official source at npm gitHead.
exceptions.action: Include notices from the matching upstream commit.

exceptions.finding: Package metadata and README declare MIT, but a full copyright and permission text was not located in this review.
exceptions.action: Resolve source notice provenance or replace the dependency before releasing affected artifacts.

exceptions.finding: ISC declared in metadata; no complete notice or source repository located.
exceptions.action: Verify it is excluded from the chosen browser export artifact, or remove/replace this unnecessary Node placeholder dependency in a licensed fork; otherwise resolve its notice before release.

exceptions.finding: Package metadata declares ISC; published README includes MIT text for repository contributions.
exceptions.action: Resolve and record the applicable notices, preserving the observed texts; do not silently classify from metadata alone.

exceptions.finding: Bundled HarfBuzz WASM and harfbuzzjs have notices separate from the core Apache license.
exceptions.action: Preserve THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and licenses/HarfBuzz-COPYING.txt, including bundled code notices.

exceptions.finding: Separately inspected optional font pack: Apache-2.0 AND OFL-1.1 AND GUST Font License (references LPPL). Not included in this dependency lock.
exceptions.action: Default to an independently curated OFL font set; do not label all fonts Apache or MIT.
